patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical padding, creating clear visual breaks between distinct content blocks.
Large, prominent sans-serif headings are used to introduce each major content section, establishing a strong hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of dark charcoal/black text and backgrounds against clean white content areas, punctuated by natural tones in imagery.
The hero video background exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content, while the main navigation remains sticky at the top.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by a large, centered heading and often featuring a grid of related cards or images.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background that creates a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the video moves at a slower rate than the main content, enhancing depth perception. The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring it remains visible and accessible as the user scrolls. Content sections are designed with ample vertical spacing and often feature a grid layout for presenting related items, ensuring readability and visual balance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, clean sans-serif headings (~3x body for H1, ~2x body for H2) with generous line height, paired with a readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, with sharp corners for content cards and overall layout structure.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout content sections, with an airy hero section that provides significant visual breathing room.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated, cinematic video hero with a subtle parallax effect, which immediately conveys a premium and experiential brand. This is paired with an exceptionally clean, almost editorial layout that prioritizes large, impactful imagery and clear typography, creating a sense of calm authority rather than overt salesmanship.
